summary: This study evaluated the diagnostic value of spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) for polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy (PCV) through a meta-analysis of 12 studies involving 1,348 eyes. The results showed that SD-OCT had high sensitivity (0.87) and specificity (0.83) for diagnosing PCV, with a diagnostic odds ratio of 36.07 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.9429. The study recommended combining SD-OCT with color fundus photography for improved diagnostic efficacy, especially in the absence of indocyanine green angiography.
